Name: My Submarine
Author: tikamin557
Description:
When you become friendly with Maru, she will give you a special gift.

The submarine's liberation flag requires progress on the Island.
Therefore, it is not possible to cross to Ginger Island with this mod prior to fixing Willie's boat.

Support for "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿".
Support for "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15939]Lnh's Ginger Island Overhaul[/url]".
Support for "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16326]The Fishmonger - Custom NPC[/url]".
Support for "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7176]The Cowboy Life Expanded[/url]".

Currently, English, Japanese and Chinese and Thai are supported.
